text: Being here, I am struck by the curious tension between seeking approval and the joyful innocence of the moment. The adult's questioning gaze and careful recording of my judgment blends with the youthful exuberance that follows, as eager faces lean close to me. I feel watched and needed, my opinion mattering in the quiet rituals of everyday life—a reminder that even mundane affirmations can shape the spirit of a shared day. I feel important, perhaps a touch self-conscious, but warmed by the lively energy surrounding me.
